title_en: Credit Exchange with Other Korean Universities for the 2026 Winter Session: Applications
summary: Students who meet the eligibility requirements and wish to take courses at a domestic partner university during the 2026 winter session must check each partner university's own schedule on the mySNU student notice board and apply through mySNU (학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학신청), uploading the required forms. Recruitment schedules differ by partner university, so students must keep checking the student notice board themselves; applications are accepted only if the official letter reaches the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과) by the deadline. Changes and cancellations must also be made in mySNU and approved, and cancellation must be requested within the first half of the course weeks.
applies_to: Optional; applies to students who wish to take courses at another Korean (domestic) partner university during the 2026 winter session. Applicants must meet all of the following: (a) no disciplinary action under the university regulations; (b) have grades for at least one completed regular semester; (c) a GPA for completed semesters of at least 2.7 (undergraduate) or at least 3.3 (graduate). Students expecting to graduate are advised not to apply. Transfer students who already have at least half of the minimum credits required for their degree recognised as SNU credits cannot have exchange credits recognised.

dates.what: Session in which the exchange courses are taken (2026 winter session)
Deadline to request cancellation of exchange study online in mySNU (for students cancelling)
dates.when: Within the first half of the course's teaching weeks

conditions: Applicants must have no disciplinary record, at least one completed regular semester with grades, and a GPA of at least 2.7 (undergraduate) or 3.3 (graduate).
The total credits applied for, including credits registered at SNU, must not exceed 9.
Credits earned at other universities in Korea or abroad may not exceed half of the minimum credits required for your degree.
Transfer students who already have at least half of the minimum degree credits recognised as SNU credits cannot have exchange credits recognised.
Recruitment schedules differ by partner university; you must check the student notice board yourself, and the full schedule is not given in this notice.
If you do not change or cancel a course through the required procedure, the grade sent by the partner university may be entered on your SNU transcript as it is.

Exchange courses can be recognised only as general electives (일반선택) or major electives (전공선택); if the course classification confirmation (교과구분 확인서) is not submitted, the course is treated as a general elective.

Major-elective recognition for a primary-major course requires a confirmation bearing the official seal of your department head; for a double major or minor, you must also obtain and submit confirmation from that department's head.
Exchange grades are recorded exactly as sent by the partner university (100-point scores are converted to SNU grades) but are not included in your GPA.
Exchange grades are entered on the partner university's academic schedule and may be delayed, so students expecting to graduate are advised not to apply.
Only official letters that reach the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과) by the submission deadline are accepted.
Excel forms must be submitted as the original file; PDF, photo files and printed copies are not accepted.
Check your personal details and eligibility carefully when applying.
steps: Application: Read the attachments (application guide, list of 54 domestic partner universities, the student manual for applying/changing/cancelling, and the forms package); their contents were not read for this translation.
Application: Check each partner university's credit exchange schedule in mySNU → 정보광장 → 게시판 → 학생공지 게시판 (Student Notice Board), and keep checking it, as schedules differ.
Application: Download the credit exchange application form and other files attached to the partner university's post and complete them.

Application: Apply online in mySNU → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학신청 (Application to Study at Another Domestic University), following the domestic exchange (OUT) application manual; print the study application (수학신청원) and course classification confirmation (교과구분 확인서) from this screen.
Application: Upload the credit exchange application form (original Excel file), the study application (수학신청원) and other related documents as attachments when applying.
Changing a course: Change the course following the partner university's procedure.
Changing a course: Submit the change online in mySNU → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학변경신청 (Change Request).
Changing a course: Request approval of the change from your department office and the Office of Academic Affairs staff member (contact details are in the original notice).
Cancelling: Cancel the course following the partner university's procedure.
Cancelling: Within the first half of the course weeks, request cancellation online in mySNU → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학변경신청.

Cancelling: Submit the study cancellation request (수학신청 취소원) through your department (via your college); the department sends it to the Office of Academic Affairs as an official letter, and the Office of Academic Affairs then sends a cancellation letter to the partner university.

Major-elective recognition: Submit the course classification confirmation (교과구분 확인서), bearing the official seal of your department head, through your department to the Office of Academic Affairs as an official letter; for double major or minor courses, also submit confirmation from that department's head.
translation:
Applications for credit exchange with other domestic (Korean) universities for the 2026 winter session are announced as follows.

1. Eligibility
a. Students with no disciplinary action under the university regulations,
b. who have grades for at least one completed regular semester, and
c. whose GPA for completed semesters is at least 2.7 (undergraduate) or at least 3.3 (graduate).

2. Credits and semesters
a. You may apply for up to 9 credits, including credits registered at SNU.
b. Credits earned at other universities in Korea or abroad may not exceed half of the minimum credits required for a degree in your college/graduate school.
※ Transfer students who have had at least half of the minimum credits required for their degree recognised as SNU credits cannot have credits recognised through exchange study.

3. Application procedure
a. Check each partner university's credit exchange schedule
- mySNU portal → 정보광장 → 게시판 → 학생공지 게시판 (Student Notice Board)
- Download and complete the credit exchange application form and other files attached to each partner university's post.
※ Recruitment schedules differ by partner university, so students must keep checking the Student Notice Board themselves for each partner university's schedule.
b. Online application for domestic credit exchange
- mySNU portal → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학신청
- The study application (수학신청원) and course classification confirmation (교과구분 확인서) can be printed from this screen.
- For details of the online application, refer to the domestic exchange (OUT) application manual.
c. Upload the credit exchange application form (Excel, etc.), the study application (수학신청원) and other related documents as attachments when applying.

4. Changing and cancelling exchange study
a. To change an exchange course:
1) Change the course following the procedure set by the partner university.
2) Submit the course change online at mySNU → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학변경신청.
3) Request approval of the change from your department and the Office of Academic Affairs (학사과) staff (contact details in the original notice).
b. To cancel exchange study:
1) Cancel the course following the procedure set by the partner university.
2) Within the first half of the course weeks, request cancellation online at mySNU → 학사정보 → 대외교류 → 국내교환학생 → 국내타교수학변경신청.
3) Submit the study cancellation request (수학신청 취소원) to the Office of Academic Affairs as an official letter through your department (via your college) (the department handles the official letter).
4) The SNU Office of Academic Affairs sends an official cancellation letter to the responsible office of the partner university (the department handles the official letter).
※ Note that if you do not change or cancel a course according to this procedure, the grade sent by the partner university may be entered on your SNU transcript as it is.

5. Credit recognition
a. To have a completed course recognised as a major elective (전공선택), submit the course classification confirmation (교과구분 확인서) through your department to the Office of Academic Affairs as an official letter.
※ Courses taken through credit exchange can be recognised only as general electives (일반선택) or major electives (전공선택).
- If the confirmation is not submitted, the course is treated as a general elective.
- For major-elective recognition of a primary-major course, submit the confirmation bearing the official seal of your department head.
- For major-elective recognition of a double major or minor course, additionally submit confirmation of major recognition from the head of that double major or minor department.
b. Grades for courses taken through credit exchange are recorded in the academic record exactly as sent by the partner university in its official letter (if sent as 100-point scores, they are converted to SNU grades), and are not included in the GPA.
c. Grades for courses taken at other domestic universities are entered according to the partner university's academic calendar and may be delayed, so students expecting to graduate should avoid applying.

6. Other notes
a. Only official letters that reach the Office of Academic Affairs within the submission deadline are accepted, so observe the deadline strictly.
b. Check your personal details and eligibility carefully when applying.
c. Excel forms must be submitted as original files (PDF, photo files and printed copies are not accepted).
d. For questions not covered here:
- How to submit exchange study documents: contact your department office.
- Future schedules of partner universities not yet announced: contact the partner university's academic affairs office.
- Other credit exchange questions: SNU Office of Academic Affairs exchange study staff (contact details in the original notice).
